description: Pending order (class ApprovalRoutings, AR- number, approval status) the declared account submitted for approval: the Pending Orders list shows the user's own requests (approver steps separate). Outputs: number, status, date, counts. Read only.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account that owns the pending order as its submitter: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username. Left out (verification only): any owner

status.description: Pending order status code, normalised: pendingapproval, approved or rejected. Left out: any listed status

minPendingOrders.description: Pending orders (approval statuses) the account must own on the store (at least)

maxPendingOrders.description: Most pending orders allowed, e.g. the page size so all fit one page. Left out: no upper bound

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
